name: m19-fall-dive-video
command: env NMC_GPU_WAIT_S=45 node --experimental-strip-types apps/headless/proofs/m19-penguin-anim.ts --capture --clips fall,dive --seconds 4 --output proofs/m19

name: m19-mid-waddle-judge
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" proofs/m19/waddle.png --description "In-game mid-waddle skinned penguin: rounded dark body, cream face and belly, two black eyes, orange beak and separate orange feet, long flippers attached at the shoulders. Match the silhouette, proportions and materials of /refs/penguin-base-ortho.png; the pose must remain coherent without detached parts or torn skin." --reference /refs/penguin-base-ortho.png --min-score 6

name: m19-cheer-judge
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" proofs/m19/emote.cheer.png --description "Skinned penguin performing emote.cheer: both long flippers raised above its head into a broad celebratory V. Rounded dark body, cream face and belly, two black eyes, orange beak and separate orange feet. Match the silhouette, proportions and materials of /refs/penguin-base-ortho.png; keep coherent skin and attached parts." --reference /refs/penguin-base-ortho.png --min-score 6

name: m19-laugh-judge
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" proofs/m19/emote.laugh.png --description "Skinned penguin performing emote.laugh in a head-toss chuckle pose: tilted head, flippers shaking near its sides, rounded body with cream face and belly, two black eyes, orange beak and separate orange feet. Match /refs/penguin-base-ortho.png and keep coherent skin. The beak is rigidly attached to head; independent jaw articulation is not required." --reference /refs/penguin-base-ortho.png --min-score 6
